name: Will's Journal
content:
Will's Journal - Entry One

 Ant has gone missing, he ran ahead and now we can't find him. Something keeps screaming and shouting around here too. JW said it's just a fox but it sounds almost human to me. I swear I'll kill the new guy if he's playing a prank.|Entry Two

I'm alone down here. Brad wondered back to find the elevator, he seemed over the whole thing, the sounds really bothered him whilst JW ran ahead to catch-up with Ant.

Why did she leave me like that? I don't know where the other exit is!|I'm running out of battery on my flashlight now and I'm starting to get hungry. I can't find the damn elevator and those sounds... they just drone on and on.

This trip blows.|Final Entry

Ant is dead. I don't know what the hell happened but he's gone, torn into pieces and left in a pool of his own blood.

I ran away and hid but now my flashlight is almost dead. Soon it will be me and the darkness, and the screams... Please God, protect me!|The screams are closer now... They're so loud. All around me. I don't want to die. I still ha-
